In Yunnan, there are many fruits with a sweet-and-sour flavor, but goldenberries are not often talked about. They are also known as lantern fruits. When ripe, they turn a bright golden yellow, wrapped in a thin, paper-like husk. Hanging from the branches, they look like little lanterns.
Peel away the delicate outer husk, and inside is a small, round, translucent fruit. With just one bite, the juice bursts in your mouth—sweet, tart, and carrying a faint, refreshing fragrance.
Fresh goldenberries can be eaten directly or used in cooking. Their bright sweet-and-sour flavor does not overpower other ingredients, but gently brings out their natural freshness.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
